WOODWORK — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Overview of Woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Overview of Woodwork.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Overview of Woodwork.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Overview of Woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. When learning Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Overview of Woodwork 1.2 Wood Workshop 1.3 Hand Tools and Equipment 2.0 Material.

   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

   C. Ignore burnt cables

9. When learning Hand Tools and equipment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hand Tools and equipment.
